--- Table 1: adventureworks.production.productphoto ---
Domain: Product
Description: Product images.
Fields:
  - largephoto (bytea): Binary large object holding the high‑resolution product photo displayed on detail pages.
  - thumbnailphoto (bytea): Binary thumbnail image used for quick previews and list views.
  - thumbnailphotofilename (character varying(50)): File name of the thumbnail image stored in the system.
  - productphotoid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each product photo record.
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the photo record was last updated.
  - largephotofilename (character varying(50)): File name of the high‑resolution product image stored in the system.
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 2: adventureworks.production.productproductphoto ---
Domain: Product
Description: Cross-reference table mapping products and product photos.
Fields:
  - primary (boolean): Indicates whether this photo is the primary (default) image displayed for the product in catalogs and listings
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when this product-photo association was last updated for audit and synchronization purposes
  - productphotoid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key referencing the specific product photo record containing the actual image data and metadata
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key referencing the product this photo is associated with in the catalog
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.sales.salesperson ---
Domain: Sales
Description: Sales representative current information.
Fields:
  - saleslastyear (numeric): Total sales amount the salesperson achieved during the previous fiscal year
  - salesytd (numeric): Total sales amount the salesperson has achieved year-to-date in the current fiscal year
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier used for database replication and synchronization across systems
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the geographic sales territory assigned to and managed by the salesperson
  - commissionpct (numeric): Commission rate percentage that the salesperson earns on each sale
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the salesperson record was last updated or modified
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key reference to the underlying business entity (person) in the employee system
  - bonus (numeric): Monetary incentive awarded to the salesperson based on meeting or exceeding sales targets
  - salesquota (numeric): Target sales amount that the salesperson is expected to achieve within a defined period
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 4: adventureworks.humanresources.employeepayhistory ---
Domain: Payroll
Description: Employee pay history.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp when this pay history record was last updated in the system
  - ratechangedate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The effective date when the employee's pay rate was modified
  - payfrequency (smallint(16,0)): Payment frequency indicator specifying how often the employee is paid (e.g., 1=Biweekly, 2=Monthly)
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key reference to the employee (business entity) receiving the pay rate
  - rate (numeric): The employee's monetary pay rate, either hourly wage or annual salary amount
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 5: adventureworks.purchasing.vendor ---
Domain: Vendor
Description: Companies from whom Adventure Works Cycles purchases parts or other goods.
Fields:
  - purchasingwebserviceurl (character varying(1024)): Web service endpoint URL used for electronic data interchange and automated purchasing transactions with the vendor
  - name (character varying(50)): Official business name of the vendor or supplier company
  - activeflag (boolean): Indicator of whether the vendor is currently operational and conducting business
  - accountnumber (character varying(15)): Internal accounting code assigned to track and process financial transactions with the vendor
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier referencing the underlying business entity record for data consistency across the enterprise
  - creditrating (smallint(16,0)): Numerical assessment of the vendor's creditworthiness and financial reliability, typically on a scale where lower values indicate better credit standing
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording the most recent update to the vendor's master record for audit and synchronization purposes
  - preferredvendorstatus (boolean): Flag designating whether the vendor is approved and prioritized as a preferred supplier for purchasing decisions
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 6: adventureworks.purchasing.purchaseorderdetail ---
Domain: Procurement
Description: Individual products associated with a specific purchase order. See PurchaseOrderHeader.
Fields:
  - receivedqty (numeric(8,2)): The quantity of units actually received into inventory from the vendor
  - unitprice (numeric): The negotiated price per unit charged by the vendor for this product
  - purchaseorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key referencing the parent purchase order header that groups this line item
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp when this purchase order detail record was last updated
  - duedate (timestamp without time zone): The expected or scheduled date by which the ordered goods should be delivered
  - rejectedqty (numeric(8,2)): The quantity of received units rejected due to quality or specification issues
  - productid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the product being ordered from the catalog
  - purchaseorderdetailid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique surrogate key identifying each line item within a purchase order
  - orderqty (smallint(16,0)): The quantity of product units requested from the vendor
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 7: adventureworks.sales.creditcard ---
Domain: Payment
Description: Customer credit card information.
Fields:
  - expyear (smallint(16,0)): The 4-digit year when the credit card expires and is no longer valid for transactions
  - expmonth (smallint(16,0)): The month when the credit card expires and is no longer valid for transactions
  - cardtype (character varying(50)): The brand or network of the credit card, such as Visa, MasterCard, American Express, or Discover
  - creditcardid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for the credit card record in the system, used as a reference key for linking to customer orders
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the credit card record was last updated or modified in the system
  - cardnumber (character varying(25)): The unique credit card number used to identify and process payments for customer transactions
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 8: adventureworks.sales.customer ---
Domain: Customer
Description: Current customer information. Also see the Person and Store tables.
Fields:
  - customerid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key uniquely identifying each customer record in the system
  - storeid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key referencing the store with which the customer is associated, linking them to their primary retail location
  - personid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key linking to the Person table, identifying the individual person record that represents the customer
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier generated by the system for row-level tracking and data synchronization purposes
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key identifying the sales territory the customer belongs to, used for regional sales reporting and assignment
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the customer record was last updated or modified in the system
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 9: adventureworks.humanresources.shift ---
Domain: Human Resources
Description: Work shift lookup table.
Fields:
  - endtime (time without time zone): Scheduled end time of the work shift
  - shiftid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key and unique identifier for each work shift record
  - name (character varying(50)): Descriptive name of the shift such as Day, Evening, or Night shift
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Audit timestamp recording when the shift record was last updated
  - starttime (time without time zone): Scheduled start time of the work shift

--- Table 10: adventureworks.production.culture ---
Domain: Localization
Description: Lookup table containing the languages in which some AdventureWorks data is stored.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): The display name of the language or culture (e.g., English, Spanish, French)
  - cultureid (character(6)) [PK]: The standardized culture identifier code (e.g., en-US, es-MX) used to format dates, numbers, and currency for specific regions
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp recording when this language or culture record was last modified in the system
